definitions.gloss: job hunting; seeking employment; job search
definitions.explanation: The act of looking for a job or employment. A formal term used in official and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {求職|きゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}を{始|はじ}めた。
ハローワークで{求職|きゅうしょく}の{申|もう}し{込|こ}みをした。
examples.english: I registered as a job seeker at Hello Work (the employment office).

examples.japanese: {求職者|きゅうしょくしゃ}の{数|かず}は{景気|けいき}の{変動|へんどう}に{大|おお}きく{左右|さゆう}される。
examples.english: The number of job seekers is greatly affected by economic fluctuations.

notes: Used with する to form {求職|きゅうしょく}する (to seek employment). Common collocations: {求職|きゅうしょく}{者|しゃ} (job seeker), {求職|きゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう} (job-hunting activities), {求職|きゅうしょく}{中|ちゅう} (currently job hunting). Pairs with {求人|きゅうじん} (job offer/recruitment) — together they form the labor market: {求人|きゅうじん}{倍率|ばいりつ} (job-to-applicant ratio). Homophones: {休職|きゅうしょく} (leave of absence from work), {給食|きゅうしょく} (school lunch) — different kanji and meanings. Related: {就職|しゅうしょく} (getting a job — the result, not the search), {転職|てんしょく} (changing jobs).
